summary: In Season 9, a single versatile Aura-based team can clear Stage 14 across three different gear dungeons: Grave of Curse, Grave of Wrath, and Grave of Venom. The team utilizes Talethia as the primary damage dealer alongside Lincos, Anneliesis, and Diantha to maintain Aura synergy. Vinyara provides essential crowd control and ultimate energy reduction, allowing the same setup to defeat all three bosses.

heroes.name: Talethia

heroes.name: Vinyara
heroes.note: Provides vital ultimate energy reduction, Freeze, and Attack Penalty to neutralize boss mechanics.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Buffs Vinyara and supports the overall team flow.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Generates Aura Energy and grants coordinated attacks/damage buffs.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Restores Aura Energy for Radiance allies to maintain team skill rotations.

teams.note: A universal Stage 14 dungeon team combining Radiance Aura synergies with Vinyara's energy reduction and freeze control.

tips: Pair Vinyara with Anneliesis to boost her efficiency in controlling boss ultimates across multiple dungeon types.
Use the Deluxe Mimic familiar to complement Aura team lineups.
